ROYAL MESSAGE
Buckingham Palace, October 26th, 1945. Dear Miss Haslett,
The Queen commands me to write and say how greatly interested
Her Majesty was by all that she saw at the First Women's Electrical
Exhibition. The Queen much admired the taste and talent with which the Exhi-
bition was presented, and Her Majesty is also happy to think that it
incorporated some of the important technical work done by women in
the Services during the war, as well as holding out hopes for a happier
future for mothers and housewives by exhibiting many improvements
in the home and in connection with education.
